correctness.rationale: From the pinned RESULT.md, the shifted factor eigenprojectors are supported on disjoint factor vertex sets. Resolving collision with the join eigenvalue N gives an exact Schur-square positive-semidefinite block decomposition diag(B_X,B_Y)+J_N/N^2+pp^T. For a factor G, the complement-component argument makes ker Q_G subset ker F_s(G) for s>=3; only connected K_2 has a rank-one gain. The constant directions already lie in B-block ranges for n,m>=2; singleton blocks contribute exactly one direction. Thus rank Mhat_L(X join Y)=rho(X)+rho(Y)+1_(min orders=1)+1_(X=K2)+1_(Y=K2), where Q_G is built after subtracting the constant-direction spectral projector even if G disconnected. Finite exact spectral-projector checks on 49 pairs corroborate, not prove, the all-graph lemma.
